description: Blast your way through a thrilling 3D adventure! Use bombs to destroy obstacles, defeat monsters, and uncover power-ups. Find the hidden gate before time runs out, battle bosses, and unlock upgrades. Play solo or with a friend for nonstop action-packed fun!

title: My Happy farm
description: Welcome to farm land game – the ultimate farming adventure that brings the beauty of rural life, the challenge of resource management, and the excitement of running your very own farm straight to your browser. The game is not just about clicking and waiting; it’s about strategy, timing, and smart decisions. Do you invest in farms first or focus on crops? Should you expand your land or upgrade your equipment? Every choice matters.

title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
description: Dive into the lively universe of 'Dragon Year Jigsaw,' a comical online puzzle game set in the Chinese Dragon Year. Solve 24 levels of dragon-themed jigsaw puzzles, featuring vibrant and playful comic art. Perfect for puzzle lovers and those seeking a whimsical online experience. Join the fun – start piecing together your dragon adventure now!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures
description: Set sail in Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures, an endless pirate-themed bubble shooter! Aim, match, and pop bubbles to build combos, chase your best score, and fill the Treasure Progress bar. Unlock pirate backgrounds, matching bubble skins, and useful boosters as every run brings you closer to the next reward. Easy to play and fun to master—keep the bubbles away from the fail line and hunt for treasure!

title: Desert Rover Survival
description: Desert Rover Survival is an idle survival adventure set in a harsh desert world. Begin with a simple setup and slowly build your own desert rover, upgrading parts and improving technology to push farther into the wasteland.

title: Bubble it jam
description: Bubble it jam is a vibrant, fast-paced puzzle-shooter game where players aim and shoot colored balls to match and pop clusters of the same color.the goal is to collect color bubble, free the ropes, and complete each level. Every stage presents a new and exciting challenge, keeping gameplay fresh and engaging, combining strategy, quick reflexes, and a bit of luck for high scores.

title: Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D
description: Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D is an exciting cooperative shooter created for true fans of action and intense battles. If you like games like CS, Warface and CoD, then this project will definitely not disappoint you. Join your team and engage in battle against opponents, striving for the main goal - to get as many kills as possible. The team that first reaches the required number of frags will be the winner.

title: Easter Glamping Trip
description: This Easter, our princesses are going glamping in the mountains to relax under the sun all day long. For that, they booked the most Instagrammable glamping place in Norway, and now they need your help to get their outfits ready for the fancy trip. Play the Easter Glamping Trip game for girls, and see what jaw-dropping holiday looks you can put together for them. Then get ready to discover new challenging tasks as you continue playing this Easter game for girls. Have a blast!

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Ocean Kids Back To School
description: Welcome to Ocean Kids Back to school. It’s back to school time for these Kids. Can you help them get ready for their first day of classes? They’ll need to pick some cool outfits, new hairstyles, accessories, and school supplies too in this online dress-up and design game for girls. After you’re all done, help them to repair their vespa. Play and have fun!

title: Ragdoll Bounce
description: Jump into a fun 2D challenge where you control a ragdoll launched by a bigger ragdoll. Click to bounce on platforms and keep climbing. But be careful—missing a platform means a big fall!

title: Fun Mini Games For Princess
description: Welcome to Fun Mini Games For Princess, a collection of mini casual games for kids. Dive into the gaming world and enjoy the fun of playing at your fingertips! Whether you are a casual gamer who looks for relaxation or a skillful player with a purpose, you will find your favorite game and enjoy endless fun in our mini games. Our mini games cover a large range of categories.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 5
description: Solitaire Farm Season 5 is here with over 4,200+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps, grow unique crops, and enjoy even more relaxing solitaire fun. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this countryside journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy farm life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Spin Spin
description: Dive into Spin & Win Arcade, the ultimate spinning challenge! Test your reflexes as you spin the wheel, dodge traps, and chase rewards. Packed with arcade action, lucky spins, and endless fun, this game keeps players hooked. Perfect for US students searching for “spin wheel game,” “lucky spin,” or “spin the wheel challenge.” Get ready to spin fast, win big, and prove you’re the ultimate spinner champion!

title: Pocket Parking
description: Get all the cars out of the parking lot wthin the time limit! The car goes straight forward and backward. Move it in a direction where there are no walls or cars.

title: Zombie Siege.io
description: As a soldier at the last base with unlimited potential, you must arm yourself and battle against dangerous zombies! Use your wisdom to select the best weapons, skills, and talents to defend against waves of zombies. How many maps will you be able to save?

title: Royal puzzle Burst
description: Tap blocks of the same color to make them burst and eliminate attacking blobs! Enjoy a straightforward and gratifying game with intuitive controls.

title: Words from Words
description: "Words from Words" is an exciting game, the purpose of which is to create as many different words as possible from the letters given to you. You can create 29 words from the word «example», «maverick» includes 71 words, and "chalkboard" stores as many as 142 words. Can you solve everything?

title: Music Rush
description:
Music Rush is a 1-tap infinite and rhythmic runner where you play with iconic music stars and try to reach the highest stage in your career, while the song and the scenery evolve as you reach higher scores.

Try out 15 original songs and find out the genre you that fits you best!
- Electronic
- Rock
- Disco
- Pop
- K-Pop
- Classic
- Samba
- Latina
- Reggae
- Rap
- Medieval
- Dungeon
- Country

Try out amazing power-ups that affect your musical experience and much more!

title: Easy Obby Jump and Run Challenge Online
description: Easy Obby: Jump and Run Challenge Online is a highly dynamic game where you jump across platforms, climbing higher and higher! Overcome tricky traps, avoid dangerous obstacles and prove that your reflexes are at their best. Can you make it to the top?

title: Wood Blocks Jam
description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxing logic puzzle game with colorful wooden blocks. Your goal is to drag each block into a gate of the same color. No time limits — just calm, thoughtful gameplay.

Enjoy thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics to discover.

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: City Builder
description: How do you become the mayor of your town? Find the right valley and build everything from scratch with your own hands. Then the residents will help you make your town even better and even share their equipment!

title: Royal Kitchen: The Lost King
description:
In a lost kingdom, disaster has struck! During a knight’s tournament, a mysterious figure in a black cloak suddenly appears. The stranger casts a spell on the king, causing him to vanish without a trace right before everyone’s eyes!

The princess manages to escape from the castle, but where should she go now? How can she save her father and the entire kingdom? Will she be able to overcome all the challenges, find her father, and defeat the evil wizard?

title: Running Late
description:
You're late for work. Again. The boss is waiting at your desk, coffee in hand, and he wants the whole story.
Running Late is a card-based bluffing game where you build excuse chains out of ridiculous cards — traffic jams, pigeon negotiations, weather balloons, a dog that shows no remorse. But every card locks in facts about your story. Say you took the bus, then blame a flat tire? WIDERSPRUCH — sorry, CONTRADICTION! The red stamp slams down and your credibility takes a hit.

title: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure
description: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure is a casual battle game designed for brave boys who love fast-paced action and nonstop adventure. Control fearless heroes as you battle enemies, avoid traps, and blast your way through nervous levels. Defeat monsters to constantly upgrade. Choose your skills to ensure your survival or increase your damage! Keep moving to avoid enemy attacks! Complete all levels to win. Get coins to unlock a variety of awesome weapons. Like darts, axes, etc.

title: Cooking Cafe Food Chef
description:
Prepare and cook delicious food from all over the world in Cooking Cafe Story. Build the cafe of your dreams while serving hot meals to hungry customers at a fast pace! Don't let the time run out, practice your time management skills, and experience the craze of real cooking!

Dash from cafe's to restaurants and unlock many locations as your progress on your journey. This cooking game offers endless fun levels with challenging missions set up in each level to give you that special experience!

title: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive
description: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive is an intense survival game inspired by the thrilling challenges of the popular survival contest. Players must navigate through a series of deadly trials, testing their reflexes, strategy, and nerve. With each level, the difficulty increases, making it a true test of skill and endurance.

title: Wall Hop
description: Every wall has a purpose. Every move is a lesson. Learn the mechanics, feel the flow, and gradually unlock the mental agility needed to navigate increasingly complex challenges.

title: Horror Forest Bear
description: Imagine an angry bear that has escaped from its cave in the forest. It's very hungry and wants to eat honey. You must help the bear. The bear is starving, and it needs to eat all the honey. You need to be very careful—it's a dark and dangerous forest, full of traps and hunters. The hunters have become much stronger because they can shoot with guns now. You must avoid the hunters. Escape from them, collect all the honey, and return to the bear's cave.

title: Fruit Connect 3
description: Get ready for a tropical twist in Fruit Connect 3 – the juicy sequel to the popular fruit-matching puzzle series! This vibrant new chapter brings even more summer vibes, exotic fruits, and relaxing gameplay that fans love. Collect daily rewards, participate in limited-time summer events, and unlock fresh, fruity designs along the way. It’s a fun, family-friendly Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Office Solitaire
description: Office Solitaire is the classic solitaire variant with the objective of collecting all the cards to the top row in suited sequences from ace to king.

title: Stick Ninja Survival
description: Stick Ninja Survival is a rogue-like arcade game with 2D stickman characters and monsters. When the Red Sun comes, the sky is covered by the Red Moon, and the world becomes extremely terrifying. People fled in fear from the monster's mouth. You only need to dodge enemies and their bullets because of automatic attack. When you earn some gem resources, you can use them to upgrade your character, Skills, and Talents.

title: Press "A" to Party
description: Press A to Party is a casual arcade game collection designed for players of all ages. Gather your friends and family, settle onto the couch, and dive into the action with simple one-button controls and fast-paced gameplay. Compete against up to 4 players on the same screen, vying for the coveted title of the ultimate arcade champion. Get ready for a blast of fun and excitement at your next gathering!

title: Brainrot Mob Clash 3D
description: Welcome to the wild and chaotic world of Brainrot Mob Clash 3D. It’s a full-blown racing and fighting adventure. Dash through 3D obstacle courses, avoid deadly traps like spikes and spinning saws. Match and merge your stickman army. Crush enemy mobs in exciting action-packed battles. As you run, collect brainrot characters to increase your numbers and merge them to form powerful units.

title: Falling Dummy
description:
Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible!

Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings!

title: Sweet Merge
description: Dive into 'Sweet Merge', a relaxing and delightful game where your goal is simple: merge and combine an assortment of sweets like jellies, cakes, and candies to create a new bigger sweet. How large can you make your sweet merge?

title: Hidden Object Time Travel
description: Travel through time and explore incredible hidden object scenes! Search for treasures in dinosaur jungles, ancient civilizations, mysterious laboratories, and futuristic cities. Find cleverly hidden items, use hints, and uncover secrets across the ages.

title: Hippo Supermarket
description: Meet Jack Ma, a cute hippo who dreams of opening his own supermarket. But he doesn't know how to do it. He needs your help to make his dream come true.In this fun and addictive game, you need to merge the same items to get higher-level items, and then sell them to earn money. The more money you make, the more you can help Jack Ma build his store.

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: Super Racing
description: Compete to earn the most points across four connected courses with your favorite characters. The whole world is your racetrack in the Super Racing World game. Race from one course to another through interconnected paths that span the world. Traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more—with shifting weather patterns and a day/night cycle. Everything is connected! Collect coins and unlock new cars and characters.

title: CraftsMan 3D Gangster
description:
In the new action game CraftsMan 3D Gangster, which is exciting and similar to Minecraft, you may become a real-life gangster roaming the streets of the city. As you explore the open world, you'll encounter other criminals who are eager to wipe you off the map.

Get through every level of this fun 3D action game, where you'll face more frightening adversaries.

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: Bloxd.io
description: Bloxd.io is an IO adventure game with Minecraft-style visuals where you can navigate obstacle courses, gather resources, craft tools, battle other players, and much more. With game modes ranging from parkour challenges and creative sandbox building to combat-based gameplay, there's something for every playstyle.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Count and Bounce
description: Count And Bounce is a ball puzzle game. It guides the ball forward. Release your hand and the ball will keep moving forward. You need to turn the tiles to prevent the ball from falling. There will be calculation questions on some tiles and you need to choose the best tile to bounce based on the number of balls you have.  Have fun!

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Elemental Gloves Magic Power
description: Elemental Gloves - Magic Power is a superpower arcade game.  Experience the fun of superpowers in magic games? Fascinated by elemental games? In this game, you can use the superpowers in the magic gloves to fight with your enemies. Shooting with flames, attacking with lightning, and attacking with electromagnetic waves, are three ways for you to choose. Don't hesitate to take the opportunity to practice real elemental magic and wipe out the bad guys. Become the greatest elemental master!

title: Girly Puzzle
description: Place blocks on the grid to form vertical or horizontal rows. When no more blocks can be placed, the game is over. Collect items to increase Your Score!

title: Head Runner Dash
description: Head Runner Dash is a 2D platformer game where you need to run, jump, and climb walls to overcome obstacles and traps. Pass the obstacles and raise the flag to complete the level. Difficult levels will make you addicted and feel challenged.

title: Telekinesis Attack
description: Use your telekinesis magic power! Gain the ability to control the power of thought! Throw your enemies wherever you want, hit them against whatever you want and deal with them however you want! Using your unique power, defeat all enemies, interact with different objects, take away weapons from enemies and be the strongest!

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Sky Maze Challenge
description: Perfect your jumps, defy gravity, and showcase your unmatched eye-hand coordination. Sky Maze Challenge demands precision and timing to overcome all of the traps and obstacles to conquer

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Paint Rush
description: White houses are boring. Bring the colors in and paint everything in seconds. Complete every level painting all white spaces. Swipe left, right, up and down and fill all the empty spots on Paint Rush

title: Gun Match Screw
description: a unique level-based puzzle game that combines screw puzzles with exciting gun-themed mechanics. In this game, each level presents you with a board shaped like different guns or gun parts, and your goal is to unlock all the boards by matching colored screws, which are represented as bullets.

title: Merge in Space
description: Merge in Space is a cosmic twist on the classic Tetris formula, where you must strategically merge falling astronomical objects of the same kind as they descend through the infinite void of space

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Grow Wars.io
description: The battle between the heroes is beginning in the Grow Wars arena in this great io game! This battle is between the evolution heroes. Step into the arena and start slashing your opponents. Earn coins and buy new equipment or heroes in the shop. This battle can be played either single or 2 player. Call a friend and start playing together!

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Real Car Parking Simulator
description:
Get ready to test your driving skills in Real Car Parking Simulator. In the parking simulation game, you will face various parking challenges. With realistic controls and detailed environments,you’ll feel like you're actually behind the wheel. From parallel parking to tight garage spaces,
this game offers many parking challenges.

title: Eat Donuts
description: Swap, rotate, and smash colorful donut rings in a vibrant 3x3 grid to create explosive matches and devour points like never before. Start with easy levels like our sunny beachside challenge—rack up scores to hit that juicy target of 800, earn shiny coins for power-ups like the mighty hammer smash or speedy rotates, and unlock endless waves of mouthwatering fun.

title: Belote 3in1
description:
Play 3 of the most popular card games with smart & powerful AI co-players, who won’t forget the game’s rules:
- French Belote – the original: a trick-taking game played by four players in two teams, using a 32-card deck, and featuring Ace-Ten cards. 
- Contrée – a variant of Belote with advanced bidding options.
- Coinche – a variant of Belote with even further advanced bidding options, declarations, and No Trumps & All Trump modes.

title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
description: The game is a fun, puzzle-based merging game where players control a dropper that releases animals onto the field. Players must carefully move the dropper to align and drop matching animals. When two of the same type collide, they merge into a higher-level animal. The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Knee Case Simulator
description: Knee Case Simulator is a delightful beauty and doctor simulation game where you get to showcase your medical skills and fashion sense! Help Tiara recover from her knee injury and give her a stylish makeover once she's feeling better.

title: Cop Run 3d
description: Cop Run 3D is an arcade-style parkour game that brings you on an exciting chase adventure! In this 3D game world, you'll play as a cop, running and jumping through the city streets. Avoid obstacles, and collect various rewards! The gameplay is simple yet fun. Use your agility to jump the fence, avoid spikes, and collect coins.

title: Monster School vs Siren Head
Candy Match 4
description: The long-awaited sequel to our popular Match 3 game! Candy Match 4 takes you on a delightful journey through the world of delicious candies. With incredible 4000+ levels you will enjoy endless fun combining candies, completing Daily Missions and Challenges, and discovering gifts along the way. Meet your friend Luffy the cat, who helps you navigate through tricky blockers and master the game. Experience one of the best Match 3 games ever!

title: Superhero Drop and Save
description: Our Super Hero is ready to save the hostages captured by the bad guys. To destroy the bad guys, jump on them and neutralize them by firing small explosions. Act carefully to avoid damaging the hostages from the explosions. You can unlocked new hero skins from the market section with the money you earn. As the levels progress, the tasks will become more difficult, but you can overcome them.

title: Stickman Dismount Simulator
description:
Stickman physics simulation. Use the turbo to smash him into barriers and traps.

Stickman Dismount: The hottest stunt action game of 2022. You will perform stunts through all the oncoming obstacles to break as many stickman bones as you can.

title: Dr. Parking
description: Ready to test your parking skills? Welcome to Dr. Parking - the super addictive car simulation game designed for all the boys who love a true driving challenge. In the game, you will drive various types of vehicles. Traverse the obstacle-laden parking lot and change corners and park your car precisely in the designated spot. And keep an eye out for keys. Each level is a test of your precision, patience, and driving instinct.

title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
description: Welcome to BFFs Y2K Fashion, the exciting new fashion designer game that lets you explore the trend of the year 2000! With a wide selection of styles from the decade, you can create the perfect look and express your fashion sense. From skater girl skirts to ripped jeans and t-shirts, or even the classic Y2K look with fun-colored low-waisted jeans and crop tops, you can customize your outfit and become an ultimate fashion designer. Play now and let your style shine!

title: Mega Lamba Ramp
description: Crazy car stunts and stunt car racing games that will give you the most thrilling experience. Perform dangerous stunts on impossible tracks in our racing and stunt simulator. Perform stunts on all the cars for your favorite characters to move to the next level!

title: Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle, where flowers bloom, bees buzz, and your mind gets a delightful workout! This unique 3D puzzle game combines stunning 2D and 3D graphics with a relaxing, chill vibe, making it the perfect escape for players of all ages.

title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
description: Shape Transform: Blob Racing is a casual running game. In this game, you will control a little Blob, running, shape-shifting, and go through various challenges! It would help if you quickly switched the Blob’s shape while running to navigate various obstacles. For example, turning into a ball helps you roll through narrow passages. When you become a square, it helps you cross flat areas more  easily.

title: Minitoss
description: Score goals, protect your goal and beat all your opponents. Keep competing until you are the king and the best on the pitch.

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Road Of Fury 4
description: Road Of Fury 4 is a scroller shooter game set in a world of post-apocalypse. Team-up with other nomads, upgrade cars, guns and super-powers and use your skills to fight through 30 levels and 3 bosses.

title: Doggi
description:
The Doggi is Adventure with Hidden Objects and Puzzles. Easy controls, simple game mechanics. Play to kill time and relax. The game doesn't require a super force and ability. This game won't bring you to hell and make you sweat. The game has hints.
The game performs in the genre of finding hidden objects with puzzles. The game has nice hand-drawn graphics. The player needs to help a little dog named Doggi collect all the hidden bones.

title: Red Escape
description: In Red Escape you must search for useful items in the series of rooms to help you escape. Look carefully around the rooms, and use your logic to solve the riddles. Find your way to escape!

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

title: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 194 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!

title: Emoji Sort – Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Emoji Sort is a fun and addictive sorting puzzle game where you match and organize cute emojis into the right tubes! Test your logic, plan your moves carefully, and enjoy hundreds of relaxing levels. Simple to play yet hard to master — perfect for puzzle lovers and casual gamers alike.

Play now and see if you can complete every emoji challenge!

Features: smooth animations, colorful visuals, satisfying gameplay, and brain-teasing fun made for everyone!

title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
description: Untangle colorful twisted ropes in this satisfying 3D brain-teaser puzzle game. Strategically select and move rope endpoints to separate tangled knots and sort them by color. Use logical thinking and spatial reasoning to solve increasingly complex rope puzzles and become a tangle master.

title: Fortune's Deck Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Fortune's Deck Solitaire, where ancient Tarot magic meets the timeless thrill of Tripeaks!

Three enchanted towers of fate await your touch - draw from the mystical deck and begin your journey through the arcana.

Inspired by the classic Tripeaks Solitaire, this magical twist invites you to clear the cards, trust your intuition, and let the deck reveal your fortune.

Will you find insight, mystery… or unexpected luck?

title: Idle Lawnmower
description: In Idle Lawnmower, embrace the tranquility of tending to your virtual lawn, earning gold with each satisfying swath cut. Utilize your earnings to upgrade your lawnmower, enhancing efficiency and earning potential in this idle game of grassy growth and financial gain.

title: Associations
description:
Find Associations between words!

There are many different levels waiting for you with no time limit. No rush, just an exciting game that will help you relax and unwind.

This game is suitable for those who want to test their wits in this interesting puzzle game!

The game will definitely interest you if you like "Wordle", "Mahjong", "Guess the words", "2048", "Nonograms", "Crosswords", "Filwords", "Three in a row", "Puzzles", "Reagents".

Have a nice game!

title: Battle of Pirate Caribbean Battle
description: Battle of Pirate: Caribbean Battle is an action-packed war game where you command a mighty pirate ship and engage in thrilling naval battles! Prepare for an epic battle war game as you sail through the Caribbean seas, fighting rival pirates, enemy warships, and legendary sea monsters. Use powerful cannons, guns, and strategic combat to conquer the ocean and become the ultimate pirate captain!

title: Money Grabber
description: In Money Grabber you collect Money before it goes into the Shredder! Upgrade your machines using cards in this survivor style tower defence game, you can unlock new cards using gems as a gacha mechanic and upgrade your machines using coins!

title: City Idle
description: City Idle is a building game where you need to build a civilization from scratch. Start by building a firepit to gather the citizens and then build huts for them to stay.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Pin Puzzle Love Story
description: Are you ready to use your logical mind to save love? In Pin Puzzle-Love Story, you face a series of interesting and challenging levels. Pull pins in the right order to solve puzzles and help couples reunite. Each level is a new Logic puzzle that can only be successfully completed by pulling the right latch!

title: Words with Prof. Wisely
description:
ind words by connecting letters. Improve your attentiveness, train your brain!

Keep in mind - some crosswords will be difficult to solve.

title: Soccer Dash
description:
Soccer dash is a soccer game in which you swipe a soccer ball through obstacles and soccer players and hit the ball to score a goal.

You have drag controls, drag to choose the direction of the kick, and release to hit the ball. During the dragging process, the game goes into a slow motion state, so you can take your time to choose the direction of the kick.

title: Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza
description:
"Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza" is an exciting cooking and business management game where you become the owner of a fast food establishment. Prepare delicious burgers, tasty pizza, and other dishes while building a restaurant empire!

Features:
Real-time cooking - fulfill orders, combine ingredients
Varied menu - burgers, pizza, fries, drinks & desserts
Business growth - open new locations, hire staff
Economic strategy - manage finances, increase profits

title: DTA 2: Maniac
description: DTA 2: Maniac. Create chaos like GTA. Use a vast arsenal of weapons, steal bulldozers, buses, police cars, tanks and much more - destruction is all around!

title: Mahjong Masters
description:
Enter the world of Mahjong Masters, where classic Mahjong meets fast-paced tile matching! 
In this exciting game, players have 2 minutes to match as many Mahjong tile pairs as possible. 
Each round is a thrilling battle against a new opponent. 
Accumulate battle points with each victory to climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate Mahjong Master.

title: Tiny Golf King
description: Simple, intuitive, fun and addicting. Make it to the top in Tiny Golf King! Complete more than 45 challenging levels and be the King of Tiny golf

title: Shoot Run Monster Hunting
description: Welcome to the interesting parkour world of Shoot Run: Monster Hunting! In this challenging game,you will be a brave shooter. Run, collect, fight and shoot all kinds of scary monsters, show your courage and skill! Enjoy running in a variety of scenarios, challenging speed and agility.

title: Halloween Match Trio
description: Halloween Match Trio is a classic match-3 puzzle game with fun challenges. Swap items to make a line of three or more matching items, horizontally or vertically. Keep matching to unlock all tiles and reach the final stage. Use power-ups like bombs, arrows, magnets, and more to clear levels faster. Complete all 75 levels to win the game!

title: Nonogram Master
description:
Nonogram Master is an exciting puzzle game based on Japanese crosswords. Solve hidden pixel pictures using numbers as clues!

Choose a comfortable control method:
PC — Left-click to fill a square, right-click to mark with an "X".
Mobile — Tap control: select a mode and tap a cell.

Customize the game, train your logic, and enjoy the process! Are you ready to become a Nonogram Master?

title: Squishy: Taba Paw ASMR
description: A cute collection of relaxing taba paws and other squishes on your smartphone! Relax by sipping squishes in different directions and enjoy sound of squishing!

title: Drive Ahead Sports
description: Want to begin a pixelated sports showdown like no other? In Drive Ahead! Sports, you’ll be behind the wheel of amazing vehicles, engaging in exciting soccer matches! Enjoy the rush of driving and the fun of the game! Use your skills to kick the ball, attack the opponent's goal, and aim for victory!

title: FRAGEN
description:
FRAGEN offers intense gunfights and challenges! With dynamic game modes, you can test your skills in different ways and become the best shooter out there!
Are you ready to join the fight? Gear up, and prove your skills!

title: Stellar Mines: Space Miner
description: Stellar Mines: Space Miner is a space mining game where you must collect resources from asteroids and sell them to get money. Buy various spaceships with different capabilities and features.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Zombie Space Episode II
description: There has been an outbreak of a zombie virus on a space station. The first group of mercenaries has disappeared. Your task is to find survivors among the zombies and find out the cause of the zombie apocalypse. You will have to fight with a horde of zombies, using different types of weapons. Look for hidden weapons in chests. Upgrade characters and weapons! Use your characters' abilities in heated battles against zombies. Play with a friend on the same device or alone!

title: Arrowtix - Train Your Brain
description: Arrowtix is a satisfying, brain-teasing puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by sliding tangled arrows out of the grid. But there's a catch: each arrow can only move in the direction it's pointing, and its escape path must be completely empty! With 60 tricky levels spread across Normal, Medium, and Hard difficulties, Arrowtix will test your spatial logic and strategic thinking. Can you untangle the mess and clear the board?

title: God's Mixer
description: Gods Mixer is a fun and experimental game where you combine different heads, bodies, and weapons to create unique characters. After assembling them, you can pit them against each other in battles to see which creation reigns supreme. The game encourages creativity through mixing and matching parts for unexpected results.

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Digit Shooter
description: Digit Shooter! plays like a vertical-version shooting running arcade game. With 3D green numbers, you can launch green numbers to shoot green numbers and numbered walls. You can shoot them and collect them to make your number bigger. Don't waste bullets and time on red walls while avoiding them. When you reach the finish line, try to focus on one line to shoot, then you will collect more rewards

title: Ladder Master - Color Run
description:
Run and collect ladder parts, grow your ladder, reach the moon!
Fun and addictive runner game for one player!
Can you make the highest ladder? Check out now!

title: That's Not My Neighbor
description: That's Not My Neighbor is a detective puzzle game. You are going to be the new janitor in this building when you are watching the tutorial video. Your job is to determine if the person who wants to enter the building is a monster. The monsters can transform into anyone and imitate them. Some monsters are not good at imitation and may develop flaws. You have no choice but to pay attention to the image of your neighbors. At the same time, remember to fill out checklists for each neighbor.

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Mart Puzzle Shopping Sort
description: Mart Puzzle - Shopping Sort is a fun blend of simulation and brain-teasing management, where you get to run your very own mini-mart! As a store manager, you will be responsible for sorting out goods and processing orders.

title: Girl Coloring Dress Up Games
description:
Brand new girl games are already waiting for you! Start creating your own coloring pages by dressing up dolls and painting pictures for backgrounds. You’ll get hundreds of color options, textures and patterns, glitter and gradients. Create your coloring book from scratch, color dresses, and improve your clothes designer skills. If you like drawing that’s the free coloring apps you’ve been looking for!
