✪ Play as a doll designer: select hair, dress up, and pick accessories
✪ Design clothes: use gradients, textures, and patterns
✪ Combine stylish looks and haircuts like in famous girl games
✪ Color without numbers and paint with glitter
✪ Create coloring pages: move and change dolls and backgrounds
✪ Zoom in and out for better results
✪ Makeover dolls and backgrounds
✪ Paint wallpaper for your phone in fun color games 
✪ Take pictures right in the game and share them with friends easily
✪ Free coloring book offline with many options

title: Merge Food Puzzle
description: Merge Food Puzzle is a synthetic puzzle game. What is different from ordinary match-3 games is that successful matches will not disappear and will generate higher-level food. The game has two modes: Merge BBQ and Merge Fruit. Merge BBQ has a variety of barbecues waiting for you to unlock, including corn, cauliflower, fish, squid, and more. Have fun!

title: Little Bugs
description: you are the guardian of a group of lost beetles. At each stage, the beetles approach two pictures. One is a safe path forward, but the other is a trapdoor into the abyss. Your mission is to decipher the hint—a piece of a vegetable or an animal—to figure out which path is safe. If you misunderstand the clue, you won't be able to reach the finish line. Every choice matters in this charming world of clever puzzles. Are you ready to lead your little bugs to safety?

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up
description: Yakuzas have captured hidden treasures and ruins. Take action to save the places from the yakuza using your samurai skills! Fight with yakuza in different locations. Destroy the yakuza using the swords and weapons found in the boxes. The future of the kingdom is in your hands. Prepare for the fight now and save the kingdom!

title: Cryptograph
description: This is a fascinating word puzzle game based on cryptograms. In the game, it is necessary to decipher words using numerical encoding. The gameplay is designed for sequential completion of levels, where each level is a quote or motivational saying. The game allows you to train your attention. A great way to have a pleasant time.

title: Robots Gone Wild
description:
Robots Gone Wild is a thrilling survival game in a sci-fi world with captivating visuals and intense shooting mechanics. Your goal is to escape from rogue robots and destroy them while navigating through hazardous environments.

To survive, keep upgrading your character and weapons.
Improve your armor, and unlock powerful guns to fend off waves of increasingly powerful robots. 

Engage in exciting battles, and explore beautiful environments that immerse you in the chaos of a world gone wild.

title: Puzzle Masters: Travelers
description:
Puzzle Masters Travelers is a relaxing and colorful jigsaw puzzle game where you assemble beautiful landscapes from dozens of pieces.
Travel across stunning locations around the world, unlock new sceneries, and enjoy the soothing atmosphere of discovery!
Use helpful boosters to finish each picture before the timer runs out. Challenge your focus, patience, and speed — and become a true puzzle master!

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Order of Operation Challenge
description: Follow the order of operations to solve each expression. Use BODMAS / PEMDAS rules. Solve brackets (parentheses) first, then powers and square roots. Next, solve multiplication and division from left to right. Finally, solve addition and subtraction from left to right. Choose the correct answer from four options. Select a mode: Easy, Normal, Hard, or Pro. Solve 15 questions to advance to the next level. Harder modes give more XP.

title: King Kong Kart Racing
description: Get ready for an exhilarating kart racing experience in King Kong Kart Racing, where you'll navigate thrilling tracks, outmaneuver opponents, and collect fuel packs to extend your runway, all while immersing yourself in a fun cartoon theme, complete with simple controls for both desktop and mobile users and a great racing soundtrack.

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Mathematics Racing
description: Welcome to Mathematics Racing, the thrilling game where your math skills determine your speed on the track! Dive into a world where solving math problems propels you to victory. Here's what you need to know.

title: Rope Rescue! - Unique Puzzle
description: Rope Rescue is a puzzle game with simple controls but a challenging twist. Strategize to save everyone using ropes while dodging tricky traps and obstacles. Stay sharp to overcome each level and claim exciting rewards. With its easy-to-learn mechanics and increasingly complex challenges, this game will keep you hooked as you perfect your rescue skills!

title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle, a classic sliding puzzle game that lets you use your mind.You can feel a sense of accomplishment! Sliding the board to create the channel for the ball to roll smoothly to the end. You should use your logical mind to cleverly move blocks, avoid
obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Have you ever wished to master magic without any innate abilities? In this game, you'll lead Luna, a curious little creature with big dreams of becoming a wizard, through intricate and ever-challenging mazes. Set in an enchanting autumn forest, your goal is to gather magical artifacts, unlock gates, and navigate through teleportation portals to complete each level. The challenges will intensify, but so will the thrill. Can you help Luna prove that perseverance surpasses magic?

title: Valentine's Day Couple Date
description: Experience the charm of Paris in Valentine's Day Couple Date, an amazing couple dress-up game for girls. Start with a picturesque breakfast and help Ellie glam up. Next, keep their fitness streak alive with a couple's workout as you dress them both in fashionable gym outfits and accessories. Later, style Ellie & Ben for a dreamy rooftop dinner. Choose from trendy clothing, accessories, and chic hairstyles to create the perfect romantic ambiance. Stay tuned for a special surprise from Ben.

title: Art Salon
description: Welcome to Art Salon - Makeup & Nails, where your creativity knows no bounds! ? Whether you're passionate about fashion, beauty care, or just looking for a fun, relaxing game, this is the perfect app for you. From designing acrylic nails to creating stunning makeup looks, step into a world of endless beauty transformations in 3D! ??

title: TicToc Braided Hairstyles
description: Do you want to get in on the coolest hairstyles out there? We've got a braided hair game that'll blow your mind. Meet our two main characters: Regina and Kiki. They're here to show you the hippest braids around—and Brian, the hairstylist who will create them, will tell you how it's done. Once you've got the perfect braid for your girl, customize it even more! And when you're done with the hair, dress your girl up in some cute clothes! This is your moment to shine, what are you waiting for?

title: Trolley fun
description: Trains connect cities and carry goods, but bandits are constantly attacking them! Collect resources, upgrade your train to repel all attacks!

title: Zombie Rodeo Multiplication
description: Don't let your zombie lose his head or other body parts in this Halloween themed multiplication math game. Answer the multiplication problem correctly before time runs out so your zombie doesn't lose a body part. If you answer incorrectly or time runs out before you get the correct answer, a body part falls off of your zombie. Once all of his body parts fall off, the game is over.  See how far you can go and earn coins to get upgrades.  Four difficulty settings to choose from.

title: Toilet Time
description: Toilet Time is more than just a puzzle game—it’s a hilarious journey into the quirkiest parts of everyday life. Challenge yourself with toilet-inspired puzzles that combine creativity, wit, and humor.

title: GoKarts.io
description: GoKarts.io is a wild 3D multiplayer kart combat game where speed and strategy collide in explosive arenas. You’ll race, battle, and outmaneuver rivals using an arsenal of crazy weapons and power-ups.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Cupid Unchained
description:
Take aim, shoot true, and break the chains of fate!
Rescue trapped souls using your trusty bow as you solve clever physics puzzles, shatter chains, and free everyone before time runs out!

title: Neko's Adventure
description: Neko’s Adventure is a vibrant platformer starring Neko, a playful cat trying to rescue his girlfriend. Explore 20 challenging levels, unlock the Power Beam to shoot fire, and face quirky enemies in a whimsical, fast-paced adventure full of charm, excitement, and cartoon fun!

title: Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures
description:
Ready to go on a magical quest through a land made of candy?
Jump into Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures - where every corner is bursting with sweetness and surprises!

The streets are sprinkled with tasty treats, and they’re all yours to match! Find the snacky pairs, clear the board, and munch your way through this delicious adventure.

Can you collect all the colorful, candy-coated tiles? Play now and let's find out!

title: Miner's Fury!
description:
Miner's Fury! Avoid and destroy!

Clear and destroy rock waves. Lookout for mystery rocks too! Buy and deploy Turrets to breeze through levels. 
Collect the coins that drop from the destroyed rocks, and spend them buying Turrets, and to Upgrade yourself. Upgrades will make you deal more damage faster, earn more coins, as well as improving your spawned Turrets.
Lookout for Missions to earn rewards!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Load The Dishes ASMR
description:
Load The Dishes ASMR is a puzzle game that puts you in comfort and fun! Your task is to sort different colored dishes and put them in the dishwasher. By organizing your cutlery in an organized way, you will find that this is not just a simple puzzle challenge, but also a super
relaxing ASMR sound experience.

title: Family Simulator Beach Games
description: Get ready to enjoy exciting winter holidays with your virtual family in this fun filled family vacation simulator. Travel with mom, dad, and family members to beautiful vacation destinations and experience memorable picnic adventures. Complete thrilling activities, explore amazing locations, and enjoy realistic family life in this vacation simulator game.

title: Pop Fruit
description:
Pop Fruit is a bright and relaxing fruit-sorting puzzle game. Each bubble contains different fruits, and your goal is to pick the right fruits and place them into baskets. Match three identical fruits in a basket to clear them and keep the board moving.
Plan your moves carefully, because baskets have limited space.
Clear fruits, complete each level, and unlock more challenging stages with new fruit combinations.

title: Jailbreak Assault
description: In Jailbreak Assault, you’re a prisoner on a daring escape mission. Starting in your cell, you grab a key dropped by a guard, unlock the door, and arm yourself with a baton. Battle guards, destroy vital documents, disable cameras, and unlock new areas as you fight your way through each mission. Eventually, you’ll secure a gun from the armory, using it to take on the heavily guarded outer perimeter. Can you make it to freedom?

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Flip Knife
description: Explore different rooms, jump on all sorts of objects: shelves, tables, chairs, sofas, and even subwoofers!Make the knife jump or even double flip. How? Just tap the screen at the right moment and jump!

title: Boom Land Lite
description: Boom Land Lite is a puzzle game where you have the role of a demolition man. You've got several types of bombs to demolish a variety of buildings.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Block Craft 3D School
description: Welcome to Block Craft 3D-School. Here creativity meets adventure! In this pixel-style game, you will enter a world of endless possibilities, like Minecraft. To build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes! But be careful that this isn't just a building game! Enemies hide anywhere and are ready to hit you! Besides, collect and place blocks.

title: Harvesting Veggies
description: Players will take on the role of a farmer, planting vegetables and achieving a full row or column to harvest. The game is based on a cartoon style, with a fresh and cute overall aesthetic, making it fun and addictive to play.

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Beat Blader 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate rhythm experience with Beat Blader 3D, where music meets action! Slash your way through vibrant, futuristic landscapes in sync with the beat of your favorite songs. Armed with dual energy blades, you’ll slice through incoming obstacles, hitting targets in perfect harmony with the rhythm, all while dodging challenges that appear in time with the music.

title: Hook Master Mafia City
description:
Hook Master: Mafia City is a casual puzzle game that combines puzzle solving, escape and collecting elements. In this dangerous city, you have to solve puzzles with your smart mind and use a cool grappling hook and swing skills, like a secret agent's flexible dodge, precise strike
and successfully escape the enemy hunt! There are two kinds of gameplay: grappling and swinging. Use the grapple for flexible movement, quickly across the city by snagging walls, buildings and so on.

title: Cars Merge
description:
Feel the thrill as racing cars zoom by at lightning speed on the track!

Get your hands on these incredible cars and watch them blaze across the raceway. Show off your passion for speed and excitement by collecting them all!

How many will you collect? Play now and find out!

title: Avenger Guard
description: Dark forces have destroyed your homeland—rise as the Avenger Guard! Merge heroes to unlock power, fortify defenses, and take vengeance. Lead your legendary squad to repel waves of enemies, upgrade through fusion, and reclaim what’s yours. Will you be the last line of defense?

title: Looper
description:
Looper is a joyous and melodious music game that tests your sense of rhythm and timing. Get ready to start tapping your way through a colorful universe of beats and melodies! With hundreds of unique levels, Looper is the perfect game to soothe your puzzling needs.

As you progress, the constellations become more complex, and the beats more satisfying. But be warned, mistiming a tap could lead to an epic crash and burn - so make sure to bring your A-game!

title: Get a cool gun!
description:
The dynamic gun runner game gives a shooting experience with the creation and evolution of weapons. Combine parts to get new weapon modules.
Shoot obstacles and enemies to unlock an arsenal of powerful weapons. Test your marksmanship by shooting at targets and enemies.
Improve your firepower by creating and combining weapon parts. Follow the evolution of weapons, from simple firearms to advanced weaponry. Become a true master of weapon creation!

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Slenderman Back to School
description: On a very mysterious night you wake up and find yourself trapped in your high school, a town in Massachusetts, and you will have to survive until dawn and escape from the urban legend Slenderman. In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

title: Bang Bang Mahjong
description:
In Bang Bang Mahjong, we mix classic Mahjong with a sliding puzzle twist. It might seem simple at first, but as the levels get trickier, every move counts. Move the tiles around and match identical ones.

Power-ups like shuffle, remove, or hints can help when things get tough. With each completed level, the challenge grows—but so does the satisfaction of solving it. Who can master every puzzle and clear the board like a pro?

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Meow Market
description: In Meow Market, players take on the role of a charming white tabby cat running a bustling vegetable shop. To keep the business thriving, players must harvest fresh veggies by engaging in a click-match puzzle game. Selecting grouped matching vegetables to harvest them efficiently. Each harvest consumes one move, which regenerates over time, encouraging strategic decision-making.

title: Ship Factory Tycoon
description: Play Ship Factory Tycoon free online and build your industrial empire in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Manage production lines, automate workflows, and upgrade your shipyard in a smart strategy experience that feels like a rewarding brain game. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly. Optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks or long-term tycoon planning anytime

title: Panda Adventure
description: A small panda has to go through many challenges to reach his home safely form school. there will be many challenges on the way

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Grand Theft NY
description:
This amazing 3D game is a free online take on the legendary Grand Theft Auto game. As you play, you'll take control of a thief with assignments all throughout New York City. You have complete freedom to run and explore the game's open world.

Using the arrows to guide you to the control points, you must sprint across the city and complete over ten interactive levels.

In each level, you have the option to play missions with certain goals or just explore the world at your leisure.

title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
description: Welcome to Moto Cabbie Simulator, where the thrill of the open road meets the fast-paced world of urban transportation! In this exhilarating and immersive gaming experience, players take on the role of a daring motorcycle taxi rider navigating the bustling streets of a vibrant city.

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Battle Of Tank Steel
description: Are you ready to enter the world of tank battles? In Battle of Tank Steel, you’ll drive powerful tanks into intense battles. Experience endless action and shooting fun! This game puts you on a battlefield filled with challenges and strategy. You can unblock various types of tanks, each with unique capabilities and weapons.

title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
description: An incredible escape from the New Barry Prison awaits you! Cool locations, parkour and obby. Show your agility to avoid getting caught by Barry.

title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
description: Join Tung Tung Sahur, the wooden drum-carrying dawn caller, as he bounces and flips through a neon cityscape just before sunrise! Dodge spikes, leap over traps, and time your jumps to the beat of his signature “tung-tung!” calls. In this Geometry Dash–inspired challenge, the streets are alive with glowing gates, speed pads, and tricky gravity flips. Can you drum your way to the end without missing a beat?

title: Lipstick Collector Run
description: Lipstick Collector Run is a classic vertical arcade game with a single-button control. Your mission: collect all the lipstick parts while dodging obstacles and earn money. Unlock marked levels by completing 8 wraps. Use money to draw 8 different colors. Earn extra cash with 8 hands that boost your lipstick collection. The more lipsticks you gather, the more money you’ll make!

title: Spacebar Clicker
description: Set out on an epic cosmic adventure in Spacebar Clicker! Click your way through the space, gather light years, and recruit aliens to supercharge your journey. Unlock awesome rewards and aim for that cosmic jump to the next galaxy. Can you collect enough light years to uncover the secrets of the universe?

title: Hidden Objects Crime Scene
description:
Keep clear! It's a police crime scene, and the evidence must not be disturbed. Engage your detective instincts and dive into Hidden Objects Crime Scene!
 
Keep a sharp eye out for clues left behind by the perpetrator. Work fast, and you might solve the case!

Can you find all the pieces of evidence? Come play now, and let's find out!

title: Stickman: Dinosaur arena
description: Take command of a squad of dinosaurs and go into battle with them! Reinforce your squad, unlock new dinosaurs and upgrade existing ones. Go as far as possible and become a great Dino Commander!

title: Fix The Hoof
description: Fix The Hoof is a soothing simulation game where you take on the role of a hoof care specialist, restoring and beautifying the hooves of animals like horses, cows, and goats. Enjoy deeply satisfying ASMR moments as you clean, polish, and paint hooves in this engaging 3D experience. Earn money from your services to upgrade your farm and expand your collection of animals to care for.

title: Zoo Shap
description:
Are you ready to put your brain to the test? ZooShap: Puzzle Game is a thrilling blend of logic, deduction, and strategy that challenges you to push your critical thinking and problem-solving skills to new heights.
Use your wit and a touch of luck to solve puzzles made up of 24 unique shape-color combinations called Shaplors. Your goal is to guess the correct answer key by selecting five Shaplors from the grid.

title: Slap and Run
description: Slap and Run is a fast-paced arcade game where your goal is simple—slap as many unsuspecting pedestrians as you can and outrun the chaos that follows. Dodge obstacles, weave through streets, and stay just ahead of the growing mob.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bubble Sky
description: Bubble Sky is an ascending Bubble Shooter game that will take you to dizzying heights. Will you be able to reach space? Reach a score of 200000 points to unlock the wheel of fortune and win collectible cards to complete your album!

title: Global City
description: Global City is a city-building simulator casual game with intricate graphics and innovative designs. You're the town's mayor and have been mandated to manage resource production, complete quests for rewards, and interact with enthusiastic residents to make this town as thriving as possible.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fluffy Mania
description: Step into the charming world of Fluffy Mania, where bright, fluffy creatures are ready to test your puzzle-solving skills. This online game combines adorable visuals with clever gameplay, creating a fun and relaxing challenge. Play on desktop or mobile and dive into colorful levels full of lovable characters. Connect matching creatures, score points, and climb through progressively tricky stages.

title: Graduation Makeup Trends
description: Discover the latest makeup trends with our Graduation Makeup Trends game! From bold and fierce to soft and elegant, this game offers a variety of makeup options to suit your style. We bring 3 BFFs, each with a unique style, many makeup options, stunning dresses, and accessories for your inspiration. Mixed with floral printed dresses, golden jewelry, and holographic accessories, in the Graduation Makeup Trends game, you will find everything you need to help these girls make a statement.

title: Fashion Dye Pro
description: Fashion Dye Pro is a fun-filled shirt DIY game. Follow the hottest summer trends! Tie-dye summer clothing and beach accessories! Show off your creative skills by customizing tie-dye outfits to your liking. Get requests from customers and paint garments at will. Being creative isn't hard: first tie it up, then dye it! Unleash your DIY art cells and leave everything to the dye! Get high this summer! Come join us!

title: Memevo.io
description: Fast neon arena survival game where players collect pellets, evolve meme characters, pick boost cards, dodge hazards, battle rivals, and defeat bosses for a high score.

title: Sand Blast
description:
Sand Blast – A Satisfying Flowing-Sand Puzzle Experience, a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game built on soft, flowing sand physics!
Every block is made of loose, unstable sand — place it, and it instantly crumbles and shifts with gravity. These pieces won’t stay still, so you’ll need to think ahead and plan every move carefully.

title: Only Up Parkour 2
description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Empire City
description: Empire City is a casual management game where you strategically construct and govern a thriving empire from nothing. Build magnificent cities, develop resources, and create a unique culture while engaging in trade and diplomacy.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Marble Puzzle Quest
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Slime Attack: Puzzle!
description: In this complete action, the play-heading playing you have to choose the right arrows and hit the corresponding slugs until it became too late. Calculate the time of shots, select colors and bring down arrows on top to protect your kingdom!

title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
description:
Obby Highest Jump Ever is a click-based jumping and climbing game where every click makes you stronger. Start from a small 10M building and push your way up to massive 2500M towers as your jump power grows step by step. Each new height feels like a new milestone, and every rooftop trophy proves you earned it.

Your goal is simple: jump higher, reach the top, and collect trophies. The higher the building, the bigger the reward.

title: Italian Brainrot Challenge
description: Welcome to the Italian Brainrot Challenge quiz game with the characters from Strange Animals! Choose your difficulty and test your knowledge of the Brainrot characters. Tap the correct answer from multiple choices and collect points as you go through the world of Italian Brainrot.

title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
description:
ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a smart, direction-based puzzle game where every move counts. Your mission is to guide the arrow through intricate mazes and lead it to the exit.

Rotate tiles, shift paths, and think several steps ahead to build the perfect route. Each decision shapes the outcome, rewarding careful planning and shap logic.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Busy Bee Hive
description:
Busy Bee Hive is an engaging idle management game where you build and grow your own honey business empire! 

Start small by collecting nectar from flowers and processing it into delicious honey products. Expand your operations by unlocking new production stations, from basic honey extractors to luxury candle makers and royal jelly labs.

title: Organize It
description: Organize It is a decompression and organizing game for all players. Aren't you tired of all the clutter and chaos? Don't you just find peace when everything is in its right place and in harmony? Everything is scattered in total chaos. Only a hero can fight against all this chaos. This is your chance to organize it! Solve ingenious puzzles and organize everything to find harmony at every level. Organize, profit and become the best of the best!

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake has big dreams. She wants to be the BEST baker that Big Apple City  has ever seen and that's why she packed her bags and went to live with her Aunt Praline to the only place where a baker can go if they want to become the best in the whole world: the BIG APPLE CITY!

title: ROYAL COIN RUSH
description: Drag adjacent coins to swap them, and line up three or more vertically or horizontally to remove them. Special coins appear when 4 or more coins are matched. Mix effects by combining special items! The stage is cleared when all the target coins are erased.

title: Emoji Smasher - Smiley Game
description:
Emoji Smasher is a Hyper Casual game to make you smile while playing!
Guess the emoticon expressions in this fast-paced challenge! Tap on emojis and win this lively, emoji-filled adventure.

title: Car Out Jam
description:
Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!

title: Rope King
description: The Rope King is a fun and casual competitive game. In the game, players will control the characters to perform various strange rope skipping challenges. The game is simple and easy to use, the theme is humorous and funny, the game style is exquisite and creative, and it is matched with various funny actions and cool and dynamic sound effects. You will definitely love it.

title: Food Truck Chef Cooking
description: Welcome to Food Truck Chef Cooking, a casual food cooking simulation game online. Want to experience a day of a food truck chef? Are you curious about what the screw's work is like on an airplane? Join our best chef simulator game and resolve all your doubts. Step into the kitchen of a running truck and answer all your customers' requests. Challenge your mind and boost your thinking in this cooking management game.

title: Dead Brain
description:
“Dead Brain” puts you in the shoes of a fearless farmer standing between your crops and the undead hordes. With simple controls and intense action, players must strategically use random upgrades to survive each wave and push their limits. 
After each victorious wave, you'll get to choose a random bonus to aid your survival. Gain a new weapon, heal your hero, repair your defenses, or even boost your health!
Are you ready to defend your farm and become the ultimate zombie-slaying hero?

title: Tropical Merge
description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Draw War
description: Unleash your creativity in Draw War. This is a wonderful strategy game. Here drawing meets battles. Build a hero lineup, draw your legions, then unleash the power of your army. The numbers show the soldiers summoned. Click to send Shielded Soldiers, Soldiers on Horseback, or Super Beasts.

title: Noob: Saving friends
description:
"Noob: Saving friends" - An adventure in an interesting and captivating world with Nubik.

Together with Nubik, you will mine and sell ores, buy new pickaxes, upgrade skills, and try to uncover all the secrets! Will you be able to challenge the dragon and earn the maximum coins? Or maybe luck from the lucky block will smile upon you?

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Farm Match Seasons 2
description: Farm Match Seasons 2 is one of the new Match 3 games from the creators of the legendary Garden Tales, Forest Match and Solitaire Farm Seasons. Your friend Poppy needs your help to look after the most beautiful farm in the village. Together you will harvest strawberries, collect flowers and protect butterflies on their farm fields. What is important that you keep the farm free from weeds! The second sequel features a BIG content update with new levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy!

title: Build A Rich Queen
description: Make the most accurate choice and become the most beautiful queen! In Build A Rich Queen, you will bring your credit card. When you encounter a POS machine on the road, you can directly swipe the card to buy clothes and other decorations. These decorations will allow you to pass obstacles without directly failing the game, but you will lose these decorations. But pay attention to the road under your feet, don't fall suddenly, otherwise, you will directly fail the game.

title: Mahjong Slide Puzzle
description: Experience the thrill of Mahjong puzzles! Strategically match tiles, clear the board, and conquer challenging levels to achieve high scores!

title: Potion Sort
description: Potion Sort is a relaxing and addictive color-sorting puzzle game. Your goal is to organize colorful potions by pouring liquids between bottles until each bottle contains only one color. Plan your moves carefully, use empty bottles wisely, and solve increasingly challenging levels. Enjoy satisfying animations, vibrant colors, and hundreds of brain-teasing puzzles that will test your logic and strategy skills.

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Mahjong Tour
description: Mahjong Tour game is a cool mahjong game with colorful graphics,  challenging levels and appealing themes. Match tiles of the same type and watch them flutter away. Once you clear the screen, the level is finished and you can move on to the next.

title: Tanks
description: Tanks is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you control a powerful tank and battle through maze-like stages. Destroy enemy tanks, defend your base, and survive waves of attacks. Each level introduces new challenges that require quick reflexes and smart strategy. Easy to play but hard to master, Tanks offers fun and engaging gameplay for casual players.

title: Fidget Trading Card Toy
description: Fidget Trading Card Toy is a fidget trading game that allows you to feel the fun of collecting toy cards! In the game, you will flip cards against opponents and even use the slap feature to set off a fierce trading duel! Your goal is to collect as many rare cards as possible, increase your card collection, and gain more advantages in trading!

title: Sneaker Art
description: Sneaker Art is a creative casual art game where you become a pro sneaker designer. Grab your paintbrush, unleash your imagination, and craft unique shoe designs. Choose from a variety of laces, showcase your artwork, and sell your masterpieces in your sneaker shop. Pack your custom sneakers in stylish boxes and grow your business with every sale!

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: Army Truck Driver Online
description: Take control of a cargo army truck in a military game and deliver high-ranking soldiers to their camp. Carrying out your assignment as an army truck driver cargo in this military game is no easy feat, especially when you're an officer. The highways are filled with hazards and obstacles.

title: Driver Master Simulator
description: Driver Master Simulator is a 3D vehicle driving game. In Truck Mode, your task is to swiftly transport animals to their destinations. All transport missions have tight time constraints. Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: Grass Ranch
description: Grass Ranch is a super fun and relaxing casual game that makes you a true ranch grass-mowing master. If you like to complete simple and fun tasks in a cozy environment, then you can't miss this game. In this world of green grass, you will mow grass constantly. Keep mowing the lawn and feed some cute animals.
